name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor
description: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor is Meta’s cost-optimized API option for agentic coding workflows. It offers a 1M-token context window, dependable tool calling, and multimodal perception at $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens, with usage permitted to improve Meta’s products.
